desc: Correct the segment-tree sweep boundaries and previous-occurrence initialization to avoid invalid range updates and point assignments.
Derive the exact segment-tree update interval and activation order for maintaining the maximum over valid first split positions.
Prove the previous-occurrence update rule, including first occurrences updating every active candidate.
Precompute prefix and suffix distinct counts with correct non-empty split boundaries.
Implement the full O(N log N) Python solution with lazy propagation and fast I/O.
Verify the corrected implementation on both samples and edge cases: all equal, all distinct, and repeated values near boundaries.
